pose_name: Standard quadruped with rear frog squat
specification:
GEOMETRY ROOT — [ACTOR_1] behind [ACTOR_2] in a deep wide-footed frog squat: both feet grounded, knees wide and strongly bent, pelvis oriented toward [ACTOR_2], torso angled forward sufficiently for the specified upper-body arm contact. Keep distinct feet, shins, knees, pelvis and forearm paths; never reinterpret the rear as kneeling.

FRONT BASE QUAD — Conventional front quadruped creates a higher chest than child-like or elbow-supported fronts; the distinctive feature is the rear partner deep frog squat rather than rear kneeling.

FLOOR SUPPORT — Both front knees and both palms are on [FLOOR] in a conventional four-point stance; front torso is supported at a moderate diagonal, not forced flat to the ground.

FAMILY INVARIANT — Front hip hinge, gentle inward lower-back contour and mild anterior pelvic tilt where compatible; rear deep wide-footed squat, both rear feet grounded, never rear kneeling; one continuous floor and no furniture.

V00 CUSTOM BASELINE — Rear forearms reach forward outside the front upper arms; rear palms settle at the outer shoulders and turn inward. Keep the two upper torsos visually close.

FRONT ARM / REAR ARM COMPATIBILITY — Front support remains as named in the base; back-directed arm movement is absent in this variant. Rear forearms reach forward outside the front upper arms; rear palms settle at the outer shoulders and turn inward. Keep the two upper torsos visually close.

SPATIAL CLEARANCE — Front hips can sit above chest within achievable knee and torso range; keep rear squat feet visible, head clear and limb entry paths plausible. No support contact may vanish without the specified load transfer.

CUSTOM SOURCE — Text-only custom extension concept derived from DOGG floor-posture categories and the USDG/UADG custom rear-arm taxonomy; no photo, generated image, physical trial or successful render is asserted.

((UFDG-QUAD-V00))
approach: Workspace experimental Pass 02 calibrated from Pass 01 blind visual QA audit (4.7/10).

expected_support.A: both feet grounded wide in deep frog squat (never kneeling)
expected_support.B: both knees and both palms flat on floor in conventional four-point quadruped stance; higher chest than FWCH/ELBW
